Magic items are presented in alphabetical order.

If a magic item description capitalizes a creature’s name and presents it in bold type, that’s a visual cue pointing you to the creature’s stat block. Unless the text states otherwise, the stat block is in the Monster Manual. How to read and use a stat block is explained in the Monster Manual and to a lesser degree in the Player’s Handbook.

Equipment, Spell, and Creature Links

The Dungeon Master's Guide links to equipment, spells, and creatures from the 2024 Player's Handbook and 2024 Monster Manual which are required for full functionality.

Use the tables in this section to randomly determine magic items the characters find in your adventures. The tables are sorted first by treasure theme (as described in the Monster Manual), and then by item rarity. If an item isn't associated with a theme, roll [[/r 1d4]] to decide which table to roll on next: on a 1, roll on the Arcana tables; on a 2, Armaments; on a 3, Implements; and on a 4, Relics.
